aiLoop.title: Performance after viewing feedback
aiLoop.noObservationDescription: Changes appear after the student views the feedback and submits the same problem again. This is observational evidence, not proof of causation.

summary.improved: The next submission for the same problem passed. This is correlated evidence of improvement, not proof that the feedback caused it.
summary.shifted: The follow-up submission moved to a new issue stage; current evidence shows that the original issue changed.
summary.sameIssue: The same issue remains in the follow-up submission; current evidence does not show that it disappeared.
summary.regressed: The follow-up moved backward in the evaluation stages, but current data does not explain the cause.
summary.verdictChanged: The evaluation stage changed; more evidence is needed to determine whether this is progress.
summary.noClearChange: A follow-up submission exists, but no clear change is observable yet.
summary.awaiting: The student viewed the feedback but has not submitted the same problem again, so impact cannot be judged yet.
